next_step_summary: The first local run of the PR #257 harness reached the Gemini API but completed 0/10 cases: early requests returned transient HTTP 503 high-demand responses and later requests hit a free-tier HTTP 429 request-rate limit, so it produced no semantic provider evidence. PR #259 is a bounded corrective: default to stable gemini-3.6-flash, remove the deprecated temperature request parameter, space case requests by 15 seconds, and retry only transient 429/503 responses with bounded provider-hint/exponential waits. No Question Engine schema or corpus semantics change. The next step is a second local run and review of its generated JSON/TXT before any LLM↔Python schema change.
